items.name: Ural Spring 2021
items.information: На чемпионат нужно принести с собой медицинскую маску , перчатки и ручку . Участие на чемпиоате в маске и перчатках , в момент официальных сборок можно будет снимать маску и перчатки. Скрамблить и судить строго в маске и перчатках. И всегда делать подпись только своей ручкой . You need to bring a medical mask, gloves and a pen to the championship. Participation in the championship wearing a mask and gloves, at the time of official assemblies it will be possible to take off the mask and gloves. Scramble and judge strictly with a mask and gloves. And always sign with only your own pen.

items.name: Please Be Quiet Brisbane 2021
items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) Please note, this competition includes only blindfolded events. If you are interested in non-blindfolded events we recommend signing up to the [Speedcubing Australia mailing list](https://speedcubing.org.au/subscribe/) to be notified as new competitions are announced. Competitors are strongly encouraged to bring a guest who is familiar with the process of judging blindfolded solving. Additionally, 4x4x4 and 5x5x5 Blindfolded are strictly limited to 20 competitors due to space restrictions. This will be allocated on a first-come-first serve basis in order of payment. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! items.name: NZ South Island Championship 2021

venue.name: [Mount Pleasant Community Centre] (https://www.mpcc.org.nz/venue-hire)
venue.address: 3 McCormacks Bay Road, Mount Pleasant, Christchurch 8081, New Zealand
venue.details: Main Hall (Main Stage), Meeting Room (Blind Events)

items.information: NZ South Island Championship 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ South Island Championship 2021 is the first regional championship held in New Zealand in the lead up to Nationals later in 2021.

items.name: Santa Tecla NxN 2021

venue.name: Punto Joven Parque Cafetalon
venue.address: Punto Joven, Parque El Cafetalon, 7a. avenida Norte y 5a calle oriente, Santa Tecla.

items.information: "Santa Tecla NxN 2021" sera la primera competencia del año 2021 en el pais. Con protocolos de Bioseguridad nacionales y los establecidos por la WCA, "Santa Tecla NxN 2021" busca mantener el desarrollo del speedcubing en El Salvador de la manera mas segura posible. **- Se aceptará un máximo de UN acompañante por competidor.** **- Se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia.** **- El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.** ____ "Santa Tecla NxN 2021" will be the country's first competition of 2021. With national and WCA's Bio Security guidelines, "Santa Tecla NxN 2021" is aiming to further develop speedcubing in El Salvador in the safest way possible. **-Only ONE guest per competitor will be allowed.** **-Temperature will be taken at the venue entrance.** **-Protective mask MUST be worn at all times at the competition venue.**
